description: This file provides functions to generate options for workflows, including actions, triggers, and templates, based on user plan state and specific conditions. It imports types, enums, helper functions, and constants related to workflow configuration.

methods.name: getWorkflowActionOptions
methods.description: Generates a list of workflow action options with labels, values, and flags based on the provided translation function and plan status.

methods.name: getWorkflowTriggerOptions
methods.description: Creates trigger options for workflows, considering plan state and filtering certain trigger events.

methods.name: convertToTemplateOptions
methods.description: Converts workflow templates into option objects, adding upgrade requirements based on plan status.

methods.name: getWorkflowTemplateOptions
methods.description: Returns appropriate workflow template options based on action type, trigger, and plan state.
